## The Morning Reboot Sequence

Like an antique operating system, Chris does not instantly achieve operational readiness upon waking. The boot cycle requires dedicated cache clearance.

::: {.comic-grid}
::: {.comic-panel}
::: {.comic-caption}
PHASE 1: 0 - 15 MIN
:::
### The Soft Boot
* **Brain State:** 12% operational.
* **Audio:** Grunts, deep yawns.
* **Hazard:** High risk of bumping into doorframes.
* **Recommended Action:** Hand over warm beverage in complete silence.
:::

::: {.comic-panel}
::: {.comic-caption}
PHASE 2: 15 - 45 MIN
:::
### Caffeine Synthesis
* **Brain State:** 55% operational.
* **Audio:** Short sentences possible.
* **Progress:** Capable of recognizing familiar faces.
* **Action:** Casual greeting permitted.
:::

::: {.comic-panel}
::: {.comic-caption}
PHASE 3: 45+ MIN
:::
### Online & Ready
* **Brain State:** 100% operational.
* **Action:** Full conversation, humor, and complex planning unlocked!
:::
:::

## Dietary Guidelines & The Hangry Curve

Hunger directly impacts cognitive performance, patience buffers, and emotional equilibrium.

```
Patience Level
   ^
100|  (Full & Happy) ──────┐
 75|                       │  <- "What do you want to eat?" (Safe zone)
 50|                       └───┐
 25|                           └───┐ <- "I don't care, you pick" (Warning zone)
  0|_______________________________└───> (HANGRY ERROR 404: CRISIS)
    0hr    2hr    4hr    6hr    8hr  Time Since Last Meal
```

### Approved Fuel & Snack Matrix

| Fuel Category | Approved Selections | Disapproved / Avoid |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **Caffeine Unit** | `[ E.g. Espresso, Oat Flat White, Tea ]` | `[ Lukewarm instant coffee ]` |
| **Quick Snacks** | `[ E.g. Crisps, nuts, chocolate, fruit ]` | `[ Mysterious fridge leftovers ]` |
| **Comfort Meals** | `[ E.g. Pizza, Thai curry, Pasta, Tacos ]` | `[ Bland salads with no dressing ]` |
| **Sweet Treats** | `[ E.g. Ice cream, pastries, dark chocolate ]` | `[ Licorice, artificial candy ]` |

::: {.callout-tip}
## 💡 Emergency Snack Strategy
When Chris begins pacing aimlessly or sighing at the pantry, do not ask *"Are you hungry?"* (answer will be an unconvincing *"No, I'm fine"*). Simply place a snack within arm's reach and say nothing.
:::
